info.title: rivet-api-public
info.description: HTTP API of the Rivet control plane.

get.summary: Returns the runtime and version of the control plane. Requests with the admin token also receive the actor names served by the default namespace.

500.description: `core.internal_error`: an unexpected failure. Details are only logged on the server.

example.message: An internal error occurred

post.summary: Issues a namespace-scoped JWT. Requires the admin token, even when the deployment allows unauthenticated requests.

200.description: The issued token. The response carries `Cache-Control: no-store`.

400.description: `validation.invalid_input`: the subject exceeds 256 UTF-8 bytes, the duration is outside the allowed range, or the grant set is invalid (empty, more than 32 grants, a grant without operations or with more than 5, or a `token` or `jwt` resource). `envoy.invalid_namespace_name`: the `namespace` value is not a DNS label of 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

example.message: subject exceeds 256 UTF-8 bytes

401.description: `auth.invalid_token`: the request does not carry the admin token.

example.message: Authentication token is invalid.

403.description: `auth.issuance_disabled`: JWT issuance is not enabled for this deployment.

example.message: JWT issuance is not enabled for this deployment.
The namespace does not exist.

415.description: The request is missing the `Content-Type: application/json` header. Returned as plain text.

422.description: The JSON body does not match the request schema, for example a missing required field, a wrong type or an unknown field where unknown fields are rejected. Returned as plain text.

500.description: `core.internal_error`: an unexpected failure, including a deployment without authentication configured.

example.message: An internal error occurred

503.description: `auth.issuance_unavailable`: the signing service is temporarily unavailable. Retry the request.

example.message: The server could not issue an authentication token because the signing service is temporarily unavailable. Retry the request.

get.summary: Lists namespaces in name order, or looks up one namespace by name. Requires the admin token.

get.summary: Lists actors by IDs, by name and key, or by name. Only a listing by name is paginated.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Name of the namespace to operate in. Defaults to `default`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Actor name. Required unless `actor_ids` or `actor_id` is set. Without `key`, lists every actor with this name, newest first.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Actor key in slash-separated form. Requires `name`. Returns at most one actor.

parameters.name: actor_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated actor IDs to look up. Takes precedence over `actor_id`, `name` and `key`. IDs of missing actors or of actors in another namespace are skipped.

parameters.name: actor_id
parameters.description: Same as `actor_ids`, used when `actor_ids` is absent.

parameters.name: include_destroyed
parameters.description: Include destroyed actors. Must be exactly `true` or `false`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of actors to return for a listing by name, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 100. A page can hold fewer actors even when more remain.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response's `pagination.cursor`. Only used for a listing by name.

400.description: `actor.invalid_listing`: neither `name` nor actor IDs were given. `actor.invalid_include_destroyed`, `actor.invalid_limit`, `actor.invalid_cursor`: the parameter is malformed. `actor.invalid_key_encoding`: `key` is not in canonical slash-separated form. `envoy.invalid_namespace_name`: the `namespace` value is not a DNS label of 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

example.message: Listing actors requires a name or actor IDs.

example.message: Authentication token is invalid.

example.message: Insufficient permissions to access this resource.

key.description: Actor key in slash-separated form. An empty string for an actor without a key.

namespace.description: Name of the namespace the actor belongs to.

pool.description: Name of the node pool the actor runs in.

create_ts.description: When the actor was created, in Unix milliseconds.

start_ts.description: When the actor first started. Not recorded by this version, so always `null`.

pending_allocation_ts.description: When the actor started waiting for a node. Not recorded by this version, so always `null`.

connectable_ts.description: When the actor last became connectable. Not recorded by this version, so always `null`.

sleep_ts.description: When the actor went to sleep. Not recorded by this version, so always `null`.

reschedule_ts.description: When the actor will next try to allocate. Not recorded by this version, so always `null`.

destroy_ts.description: When the actor was destroyed, in Unix milliseconds. Only set in listings that include destroyed actors; otherwise `null`.

metadata.description: Metadata for the actor name. Currently always empty.

key.description: Actor key in canonical slash-separated form, at most 1024 bytes. Omit for an actor without a key.

input.description: Actor input as standard base64 (with padding).

pool.description: Name of the node pool to run the actor in. Defaults to `default`.

key.description: Actor key in canonical slash-separated form, at most 1024 bytes. Without a key, a new actor is always created.

input.description: Actor input as standard base64 (with padding).

pool.description: Name of the node pool to run the actor in. Defaults to `default`.

created.description: `true` if this request created the actor, `false` if it already existed.

names.description: Map from actor name to its metadata.

AuthResourceKind.description: Resource type a grant applies to.

AuthTargetScope.description: `"any"` for every resource of the type, or `{ "id": "..." }` for one resource.

namespace.description: Name of the namespace the token is scoped to. It must exist.

duration.description: Token lifetime in seconds, from 1 to the deployment's maximum. Defaults to the deployment's configured duration.

subject.description: Opaque identifier of the end user, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes. Only used for correlation.

grants.description: Access the token carries within its namespace.

issued_ts.description: When the token was issued, in Unix milliseconds.

expires_ts.description: When the token expires, in Unix milliseconds.

operations.description: Operations the grant allows on the target.

namespace.description: Name of the namespace the token is scoped to.

subject.description: Subject attached to the token, or `null`.

issued_ts.description: When the token was issued, in Unix milliseconds.

expires_ts.description: When the token expires, in Unix milliseconds.

ErrorResponse.description: A structured error. The response also carries an `x-rivet-error: <group>.<code>` header.

code.description: Error code within the group, for example `not_found`.

metadata.description: Extra details. Only present on some errors raised while authenticating or authorizing the request.

envoyProtocolVersion.description: Version of the protocol nodes use to connect to the control plane.

actorNames.description: Actor names the default namespace's connected nodes accept. Only present for requests made with the admin token.

create_ts.description: When the namespace was created, in Unix milliseconds.

name.description: Immutable namespace name. A DNS label of 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

key.description: Node key, unique within the pool.

create_ts.description: When the node connected, in Unix milliseconds.

last_ping_ts.description: When the node last sent a heartbeat, in Unix milliseconds.

stopping.description: Whether the node is shutting down.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or `null` when there are no more results.

drain_on_version_upgrade.description: Drain nodes running an older version when a newer version connects.

actor_eviction_delay.description: Seconds to wait before evicting actors from a draining node.

actor_eviction_period.description: Seconds over which actors are evicted from a draining node.

actor_eviction_rate.description: Rate at which actors are evicted from a draining node. Must be finite and greater than 0.

metadata.description: Opaque JSON stored with the pool, or `null` when unset.

PoolUpsertRequest.description: Every field is optional. Unknown fields are rejected.

drain_on_version_upgrade.description: Drain nodes running an older version when a newer version connects.

actor_eviction_delay.description: Seconds to wait before evicting actors from a draining node.

actor_eviction_period.description: Seconds over which actors are evicted from a draining node.

actor_eviction_rate.description: Rate at which actors are evicted from a draining node. Must be finite and greater than 0.

metadata.description: Opaque JSON stored with the pool, at most 16 KiB when serialized.

RivetId.description: A Rivet ID: 30 lowercase base36 characters.

bearer_auth.description: The admin token or a namespace JWT from `POST /auth/tokens`.

rivet_token_header.name: x-rivet-token
rivet_token_header.description: The same token sent in the `x-rivet-token` header instead of `Authorization`.
